pollingDistricts.title: Belfast polling districts with a separate register timetable, 1946
pollingDistricts.note: A Ministry of Home Affairs notice of 23 May 1946 set a separate electoral-register timetable (claims and objections to 1 July 1946) for these Belfast polling districts. It gives their wards, not their constituencies, and names no polling places or election; it is shown on the first election held after it, the Belfast Central by-election of 22 August 1946.
